detector.name: yolov8
detector.trained_on: Person: stock YOLOv8n, COCO-pretrained (ultralytics official release, class 0 'person'). Fire/smoke: luminous0219/fire-and-smoke-detection-yolov8, YOLOv8n fine-tuned 150 epochs on a custom Roboflow dataset (https://github.com/luminous0219/fire-and-smoke-detection-yolov8). Neither is a RESQ-custom-trained model — both are third-party checkpoints verified before use; see WORKFLOW.md Phase 8 for offline/validated retraining policy before any production use beyond the hackathon demo.

notes: Controlled, offline, validated updates only. Do not continuously retrain the core detector on raw daily CCTV — see WORKFLOW.md Phase 8.
